actions.title: Make match-day group visits easy to plan
actions.task: Review existing booking and sport pages. Where needed, clarify group arrangements, how to enquire, booking conditions and how customers can confirm which match is showing.
actions.done_when: A customer can find accurate arrangements and complete an enquiry; the team has tested the booking route.

actions.title: Answer the questions sport customers ask
actions.task: Check that the sports offering is easy to find. Clarify how to confirm fixtures, food availability during matches and relevant viewing arrangements. Improve a useful existing page first.
actions.owner: Venue manager supplies facts; website provider publishes them
actions.done_when: Information is accurate, accessible from the main navigation and assigned to someone for regular updates.

actions.title: Keep garden information clear and current
actions.task: Check garden photos and practical details, including seating, booking and access where relevant. Check key contact details and opening times across the website and principal business profiles.
actions.done_when: Customers can find current, verified information without conflicting details.

limitations: The source records 100 reviews each for Example Bar and Example Competitor Three, but supplies no usable review quotations and no explanation. No customer-sentiment claim is made here.
Website and review evidence was unavailable for Example Competitor One and Example Competitor Two. The supplied report does not demonstrate a specific competitor advantage.
The source mixes mentions and recommendations. This example treats the headline counts as appearances; check the original parser before production use.
